purpose: Diagnose the source-position sensitivity of the PFFDTD dense sub-band worsening pattern: re-execute the three canonical PFFDTD legs under the frozen solver contract with the source comms stencil moved over a frozen whole-cell offset lattice on the unchanged cartesian grid, re-derive the finite-record transfers on the unchanged 34-frequency dense grid under the same metric/pairs/thresholds, and record whether the 10->12 worsening vector moves with source position. Predeclared verbatim by docs/R130D_GENERAL3D_RECEIVER_POSITION_SENSITIVITY_RESULT_2026-10-03.md as the next pre-fixed numerical experiment.

run76_record_binding.binding_rule: the canonical cell evaluates the same persisted pressure/source records as authoritative run #76; a run that re-executes the pinned PFFDTD contract binds to those records by comparing the semantic sha256 of the recombined pressure trace and the unit discrete volume-velocity impulse source trace at every predeclared PPW level; only the canonical cell is bound to run-76 records, every moved-source cell is a re-executed variant leg with its own recorded trace digests
run76_record_binding.on_nonidentical: the computed sweep values are still emitted, but evaluation_state becomes NOT_EVALUATED_RECORD_BINDING_MISMATCH and the frozen classification is withheld so the result cannot be read as the run-76 experiment

source_position_sensitivity.axis: source-position sensitivity of the dense sub-band worsening: move only the source comms stencil over the frozen whole-cell offset lattice on each level's own cartesian grid and re-execute the pinned SimEngine on byte-copied sim asset sets; receiver stencil and readout weights, the injected signal rows, geometry, cartesian grid, boundary/staircase representation, materials, time sampling, duration, and the scored contract are unchanged

offset_lattice_convention.units: whole grid cells on the level's own uniform cartesian grid; an offset (kx,ky,kz) moves the source exact position by (kx*h, ky*h, kz*h) at that level's grid spacing h
offset_lattice_convention.moved_position_rule: the moved stencil is the trilinear stencil of the moved exact position p' = source_position_m + offset_cells*h on that level's own grid; for whole-cell offsets this is exactly the canonical eight-node in_ixyz set rigidly translated by the offset vector with the canonical per-node injected-signal rows in_sigs (and hence the trilinear source weight row they encode) unchanged
offset_lattice_convention.fail_closed_gates: a moved cell is only executable iff every moved in_ixyz node is inside the grid, no moved node sits on an outer absorbing-layer plane (any axis index 0 or N-1), and every moved node is air-connected under the frozen six-neighbor cartesian BFS of the canonical boundary representation; a cell that fails any gate blocks the diagnostic as fail-closed (ValidationBlocked)
offset_lattice_convention.determinism: the offset lattice is declared in whole cells and applied identically at every level; no fractional-cell offsets, no in_sigs reweighting, no receiver-stencil move, and no boundary/grid/constants change is permitted

source_offsets.rule: the unchanged canonical source stencil: the control cell that reproduces the canonical dense worsening vector and binds the run-76 records
source moved one cell along -x, away from the receiver (~0.43 m at PPW 8)
source moved one cell along +x, toward the receiver
source moved two cells along -x, away from the receiver
source moved two cells along +x, toward the receiver
source moved one cell along -y, lateral
source moved one cell along +y, lateral toward the sloped ceiling side
source moved two cells along -y, lateral
source moved two cells along +y, lateral toward the sloped ceiling side
source moved one cell along -z, away from the sloped ceiling
source moved one cell along +z, toward the sloped ceiling
source moved two cells along -z, toward the floor
source moved two cells along +z, toward the sloped ceiling

execution.solver_executions: the three canonical binding legs plus one re-executed variant leg per non-control cell per level on a byte-copied sim asset set (vox_out.h5, comms_out.h5, sim_consts.h5, sim_mats.h5) with only the comms in_ixyz node set replaced by the moved stencil; out_ixyz, out_alpha, in_sigs, Ns, Nr and Nt are unchanged
execution.canonical_cell_rule: reuse the canonical leg outputs that bind run76_record_binding
execution.contract_invariant: every variant leg must preserve the frozen contract byte-identically except the moved in_ixyz set: vox static authority (xv/yv/zv/h/Nx/Ny/Nz), sim consts, sim mats, out_ixyz, out_alpha, in_sigs, Ns, Nr and Nt are sha256-verified identical to the canonical leg, and the rewritten in_ixyz must equal the frozen moved stencil exactly
execution.source_injection_rule: the variant run injects the unchanged canonical in_sigs rows at the moved nodes — the same trilinear source weight row applied at the moved position — and the variant pressure record is recombined from the re-executed u_out with the unchanged canonical out_alpha row, then converted with the frozen p=rho*d(phi)/dt second-order convention and analyzed against the unchanged unit-impulse source spectrum on the dense grid

rejected_axes.reason: a non-integer offset changes the trilinear source weight row encoded in in_sigs and confounds source position with the already-executed stencil-weight axis; only whole-cell moves keep the injected-signal rows identical across variants

rejected_axes.axis: meter-fixed offsets instead of whole-cell offsets
rejected_axes.reason: a meter-fixed offset lands on different fractional cell coordinates at different PPW levels and changes the weight row per level; whole-cell offsets preserve the canonical stencil shape on every level's own grid

rejected_axes.axis: moving the receiver stencil or the source-receiver pair jointly
rejected_axes.reason: the axis isolates source-position sensitivity of the measurement pair; the receiver stencil, out_alpha and readout stay byte-identical to the canonical leg

rejected_axes.axis: in_sigs reweighting or stencil-shape changes at the moved nodes
rejected_axes.reason: the moved stencil keeps the canonical injected-signal rows; weight perturbations were already measured by the parent stencil-sensitivity axis
Ns stays 8 with the canonical eight-node stencil shape; a different injection topology would change the observable under test

rejected_axes.axis: boundary, material, time-sampling or solver-constant changes
rejected_axes.reason: those axes are covered by the voxel-staircase and time-gate diagnostics; this axis only moves the injection stencil on the unchanged executed grid

evaluation.frequency_grid_ref: the dense_frequency_neighborhood band grid of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan (34 frequencies, 36.0-44.0/76.0-84.0 Hz at 0.5 Hz)
evaluation.worsening_rule: worsening at frequency f iff d_10_12(f) > d_8_10(f); the complete predeclared grid is evaluated for every cell with no post-result selection

per_cell_classification.rule: the dense worsening-count thresholds of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan applied to each cell independently

evaluation.carries_worsening_rule: a moved cell carries the worsening iff its worsening count exceeds localized_max_count, i.e. its per-cell dense classification is MIXED or PERSISTS rather than LOCALIZED
evaluation.pattern_metric: per-cell 34-frequency worsening vector compared to the canonical cell's vector; hamming_distance = count of frequencies whose worsening bit differs

classification.rule: evaluate in order: (1) invariant iff every evaluated non-control cell reproduces the canonical worsening vector exactly; (2) position_local iff at least one evaluated non-control cell does not carry the worsening (its per-cell dense classification is localized); (3) receiver_local iff no non-control cell is localized, i.e. every moved source cell carries the worsening somewhere on the dense grid — the worsening is then a property of the receiver readout location rather than of the source-receiver pair; otherwise mixed
